summary.text: Nick Frentz is a Democratic state senator from Minnesota who represents District 18 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026 against Republican Jackie Henry.
He is an attorney who has served in the Minnesota State Senate since 2017.

paragraphs.text: Frentz was born in Mankato, Minnesota, earned a bachelor's degree from Macalester College in 1984, and received a law degree from William Mitchell College of Law in 1987.
Frentz's Ballotpedia profile lists his Senate tenure as beginning in 2017 and his current term as beginning on January 3, 2023.

In the 2025-2026 session he chaired the Energy and Utilities Finance and Policy Committee, was vice chair of the Finance Committee, and was also assigned to the Capital Investment, Commerce and Consumer Protection Finance and Policy, and Rules and Administration committees.
